evidence.frontage_band: has a lot frontage of 7.6 metres or less

calculation_handling.description: On an R-zone lot with frontage of 7.6 m or less, a vehicle entrance through the front main wall of a (non-ancillary) building is not permitted, despite 10.5.80.40(1).
calculation_handling.gaps: building_types left any: the text names only "a building, other than an ancillary building". The subject (an integral garage entrance in the front wall) is tokenised as private_garage from the heading. Whether a scheme has an integral front garage is a design choice not held for the lot.

evidence.abuts_lane: on a lot abutting a lane

calculation_handling.description: On a corner lot or a lot abutting a lane, vehicle access to any parking space must be from the flanking street or the lane.
calculation_handling.gaps: The two lot conditions are alternatives (corner lot OR lot abutting a lane), so they are recorded in application.lot_conditions and not as a conjunctive condition. The requirement token access_from_lane covers the lane arm; for a corner lot without a lane the access is from the flanking street, which has no separate requirement token.

10.10.80.40(1).explanation: On an R-zone lot 7.6 m wide or narrower, a garage door (vehicle entrance) in the front wall of the house is not allowed.

10.10.80.40(2).explanation: On a corner lot or a lot next to a lane, driveway access to parking must come from the side (flanking) street or from the lane, not the front street.
